_usage.description: HTTP POST dispatch example for empty write list notification.

possible_vars.allow_batches: boolean — whether this dispatch should be batched (default true)
possible_vars.batch_size: int — max items per batch before immediate flush (default from dispatcher constructor)
possible_vars.flush_interval_seconds: number — max wait time before flushing pending batch (seconds; default from dispatcher constructor)
possible_vars.retry_attempts: int — number of retries on failure (default 3)
possible_vars.filters: list — list of filter objects with keys 'key','value','operator' to restrict dispatch
